시편 32:1.content: A Psalm of David, Maschil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

시편 32:2.content: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

시편 32:3.content: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

시편 32:4.content: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

시편 32:5.content: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

시편 32:6.content: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

시편 32:7.content: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

시편 32:8.content: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

시편 32:9.content: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

시편 32:10.content: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.

시편 32:11.content: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
